SELECT A.IND_ID indId, A.IND_NAME indName, A.IND_TYPE indType, A.SUP_TYPE supType, A.WARN_COND warnCond, A.FOUL_COND foulCond, A.APPROVE_COND approveCond, A.IS_ENABLED isEnabled,
A.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode
FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR A
A.IND_ID not in (select IND_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR where PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND A.IND_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{indName}),'%')
AND A.IND_TYPE = #{indType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND A.SUP_TYPE = #{supType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select XMLAGG(xmlelement(E,p.PORTFOLIO_NAME || ',')).extract('//text()').getclobval() as portfConst from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL t inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO p on t.PORTFOLIO_ID=p.PORTFOLIO_ID and p.mdate > (select CUR_DATE from SYS_DATE)
t.PTL_BAG_ID = #{portfolioCode}
